blind.description: A stone cemetery statue of a weeping angel standing on a rectangular stepped plinth. The figure wears long hooded drapery with sleeves, covering its face with its hands in mourning, flanked by a pair of feathered angel wings folded back. The surface is textured as weathered, aged grey stone with green moss accumulation along upper crevices and edges. All geometry is solid, continuous, and cleanly modeled without floating artifacts.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a rounded hooded head flanked by two curved wing tops, set over a square/rectangular stepped stone pedestal base.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.8 feet tall (roughly shoulder height to the 5 ft 9 in figure), and about 1.8 feet wide at the base and wings.
